name: Command Dial
author: neostryder
description:
A worked example of ModPlugin.menu: it presents the game menu as a radial dial of wedges instead of a lettered list, laid out from the question's own choices and resolved by naming a choice's stable id.

It takes ONE question and declines every other menu in the game, which is what the seam is for: a presenter reimagines the screens it has a better idea for and leaves the rest alone.
